scope.head: f2033b0e58eb27f09d07b2be89d6737d21339b2c
scope.intent: replace the Node share helper with the Rust zos-hostd daemon and rename its runtime surface

appliedFixes: Enforced hostd-configured NAS roots instead of trusting client roots.
Rejected share paths whose real path escapes the configured NAS root.
Validated NFS allowed CIDRs at the privileged boundary.
Included stdin writes in command timeouts and bounded concurrent output reads.
Preserved migrated TOML socket-path precedence in the systemd unit.
Excluded target output from Debian source copies.
Reloaded attempted services after share configuration rollback.
Ignored pure Rust directories during npm workspace version discovery.
Added migration, IPC, rollback, race, timeout, path-safety, and packaging tests.

testingGaps: Linux systemd sandbox and real privileged-command acceptance were not available on the macOS review host.
A Debian package was not built or installed during this local review.
residualRisks: Multiple services share the zos UID accepted by hostd, so service identity is not isolated from API approval authority.
Client timeouts do not cancel hostd work and may expire before multi-command operations finish.
Disabling an individual share protocol may leave its already-running service on stale configuration.
Not every rename/remove path fsyncs its parent directory, and fstab writes are in-place.
The host installer fetches and executes rustup bootstrap content without a pinned checksum.

verification.documentation: passed: Astro check, tests, build, and internal-link validation
